div.div: 5 تأهّب He furnished, prepared, equipped, or accoutred, himself; furnished, or provided, himself with proper, or necessary, apparatus, gear, tackling, implements, instruments, tools, or the like; (S, A, Msb, K;) لِلسَّفَرِ for journeying; (Msb;) or لِلْأَمْرِ for the thing, or affair; as also ↓ أهّب . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
